name: Are CAPTCHAs Still Bot-hard? Generalized Visual CAPTCHA Solving with Agentic Vision Language Model
notes: Reviewed against the USENIX Security 2025 proceedings PDF and the authors' project page halligan.pages.dev, which the paper names as its website. In the benchmark comparison Halligan used GPT-4o and acted through PyAutoGUI on CAPTCHAs replayed from a local Flask server. The paper reports 1,577 of 2,600 benchmark challenges solved (60.7%) and a 70.6% average solve rate on previously unseen CAPTCHAs over a 30-day field study run through human-driven CAPTCHA farms. It names Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.15580923 for its source code and benchmark. No arXiv version was found.
summary: Presents Halligan, a VLM agent that abstracts visual CAPTCHAs into frames, elements and keypoints and solves each as a search problem through generated interaction code, tested on 2,600 challenges of 26 types.
